Knowledge facts: part C holds 43 fact blocks (sec13-F01 onward) from physical pages 99 to 104; part C2 holds 46 confusable and continuation blocks (sec13-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-RESP-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-RESP-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-RESP-D-POINTS — points chart rows taught from extracted text; point values need an official recheck (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-RESP-D-NOTICE — police crash notice with and without a property-damage threshold (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-RESP-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-RESP-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: point values and thresholds, the surrender fine, crash reporting dollar amounts and deadlines, the Defensive Driving Course limit and restricted license rules (for example sec13-F12, sec13-F18, sec13-F38, sec13-F39, sec13-R15) can change and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources.
